column2: Karve Nagar madhe hostel baher chi mothi kachra kundi roj bharun vahte. Kachra rastyavar padto ani kutri pasartat.
कर्वे नगर में कचरे का डिब्बा हमेशा भरा रहता है, बीमारी का डर।

The large garbage bin at the corner of our Karve Nagar street overflows every day. Waste spills onto the road where my children wait for the school bus, and dogs tear through it. I'm worried about infections. Could the bin be emptied more often, or a second one added?
सहकारनगरचा पिवळा दिवा रात्रभर लुकलुकतो, हा कसला सिग्नल?
Could the Sahakar Nagar signal work normally at night? It only blinks yellow.
Sahakar Nagar signal raatri fakt pivla, please normal kara.
Kharadi mein 'No Entry' board gayab hai.
खराडीतला 'प्रवेश बंद' फलक गायब आहे, कृपया नवा लावावा.
Kharadi madhe dukanasamorchya galli cha 'No Entry' board gayab aahe. Gaadya ulta ghustat ani customers la parking la jaga nahi. Please navin board lava.
Yerawada madhe roj sandhyakali vij jaate, riksha charge karta yet nahi. Krupaya MSEDCL la kalva.

Yerawada mein roz shaam 7 se 10 power cut hota hai. Delivery ke beech phone charge karna hota hai aur ghar pe bijli nahi. MSEDCL helpline pe koi phone nahi uthata. I'm really worried because monsoon aane wala hai aur tab aur bura hoga. Kuch schedule toh bataiye.
Yerawada la roj power cut, mulancha abhyas thambla. Worried.
Bavdhan market javal zebra crossing purna pusla aahe. Sandhyakali eklich rasta olandtana gaadya thambatach nahit, kantala aala.
The zebra crossing near the Bavdhan market has faded away. At my age crossing there is exhausting and frightening.

Bavdhan market javal zebra crossing ata disatach nahi. College la jatana roj tithun rasta olandto ani gaadya vegane yetat. Please punha paint kara, ani shakya asel tar ek pedestrian signal pan lava. It would really help students.
कसबा पेठ में मैनहोल का ढक्कन टूटा है, बाइक का पहिया फँस जाएगा!
Kasba Peth la manhole zakan tutla, free trap.
There's a broken manhole cover in Kasba Peth on my route to the office. Half of it has caved in. Please replace it.

The footpath through Camp has no ramps at all. My neighbour uses a wheelchair and we walk together on Sundays; every time, we have to go onto the road with the traffic. It would make a real difference to install a few ramps along the main stretch. Thank you for considering it.

Camp madhe footpath var ek pan ramp nahi. Aamchya dukanat wheelchair var yenare customers yeuch shakat nahit. Krupaya kahi thikani utaar banva, sagalyanna madat hoil. Aamhi dukandar pan madat karayla tayar aahot.
Camp ke footpath pe koi ramp nahi hai. College mein ek dost wheelchair use karta hai aur usse road pe chalna padta hai. Kripya kuch jagah ramp banwa dijiye, bahut madad hogi. Dhanyavaad.
Shaniwar Peth la speed limit board mothya flex mage lapla aahe. Delivery karayla jatana disat nahi.
शनिवार पेठेतला वेगमर्यादेचा फलक एका फ्लेक्समागे झाकलाय. रात्री चालताना गाड्या वेगात जातात, भीती वाटते.
The speed limit sign in Shaniwar Peth is hidden behind a big flex banner. Drivers don't slow down.
नारायण पेठ में नल से yellow पानी, पीने से डर लगता है.

Narayan Peth mein hamari dukaan ke nal se ek hafte se peela paani aa raha hai. Chai ke liye bhi paani khareedna pad raha hai. Teen baar shikayat ki, kuch nahi hua. Kya kisi ke bimaar padne ka intezaar hai?
नारायण पेठेत नळाला पिवळं पाणी! तपासणी करा!
Gokhale Nagar la hotels raatri kachra taktat, dukanasamor ghaan.

Hotels in Gokhale Nagar dump their leftover food and waste on the roadside every night. By morning the dogs have spread it everywhere and my delivery bike has to weave through it. I've reported it three times. Nothing changes. Please fine the hotels.

Gokhale Nagar mein restaurants raat ko bacha hua khaana aur kachra road ke kinare phenk dete hain. Subah dekho toh kutte aur kauve saara kachra faila dete hain. Society walon ne bhi bola, koi fark nahi. Bas thak gaye hain ab. Kripya hotels ko fine lagaaiye.
The new road on Tilak Road still has no streetlights. Fix it.
Tilak Road ki nayi sadak pe abhi tak light nahi lagi, kripya lagwa dijiye.
Tilak road cha navin rasta chamakdar, pan dive? Te pudhchya janmi.
एरंडवणा में एक building पर बिना permission नई मंज़िल बन रही है. हम senior citizens को रात भर नींद नहीं आती, और कोई देखने वाला भी नहीं!
An extra floor is being added to a building in Erandwane with no visible permission. Could the ward office verify this?

Erandwane mein ek building ke upar naya floor ban raha hai aur wahan koi permission board nahi hai. Material road pe utarta hai toh delivery bike nikalne mein dikkat hoti hai. Kripya ek baar check karwa lijiye ki sab niyam ke hisaab se hai ya nahi.
बावधनमध्ये रस्त्यावर मेलेलं जनावर तीन दिवसांपासून पडलंय. बहुधा महापालिका त्याला राष्ट्रीय स्मारक घोषित करायच्या विचारात असावी. रोज प्रवासात नाक दाबून जावं लागतं.
Bavdhan la mela prani padla aahe, mulanna tras!
Bavdhan road var dead animal, bike varun jatana ghaan vas.
Dhayari madhe hotel vale raatri kachra rastyavar taktat. Bus pakadtana sakali tithe kutri.
Dhayari mein hotel wale raat ko kachra road pe daal jaate hain. Kripya is par dhyan dijiye.
धायरीत हॉटेलवाले रात्री उरलेलं अन्न आणि कचरा सोसायटीबाहेर टाकतात. सदस्यांनी तक्रार केली आहे, कृपया कारवाई करावी.
Pashan underpass madhe dive nahit, krupaya lavave.
The Pashan underpass is completely dark at night. Residents are worried.
Pashan underpass में एक भी light नहीं, shop बंद करके वहीं से जाता हूँ. Horror movie जैसा feel आता है.
Dhankawadi में पानी सिर्फ़ 10 minute, please time बढ़ाइए.
Water in Dhankawadi comes for only ten minutes a day. Could the duration be increased? It's very hard for elderly residents.
धनकवडीत पाणी फक्त दहा मिनिटं येतं. रोज संध्याकाळी घरी येईपर्यंत पाणी गेलेलं असतं, थकून गेलेय.
एफसी रोड पर कुत्ते कचरे की थैलियाँ फाड़ देते हैं, कृपया ढक्कन वाले डिब्बे लगवाएँ।
FC Road la kutri kachra pishvya fadtat, road bhar kachra!
एफसी रोडजवळ रोज रात्री कुत्री कचऱ्याच्या पिशव्या फाडतात. सकाळी मुलांना शाळेत नेताना सगळा कचरा रस्त्यावर पसरलेला असतो. कृपया झाकणाच्या कुंड्या लावाव्यात.

Every evening cattle sit in the middle of the Balewadi high street. Walking home alone, I have to go around them into traffic because the footpath is blocked by stalls. Twice a bike nearly hit me. This has been going on for months. Please find the owners and stop it.
Balewadi high street var gaayi rastyachya madhe basun astat. Mulanna gheun jatana khup kalji vatate.
Balewadi high street pe gaayein roz beech road pe. Delivery ke time rukna padta hai, roz ka hai.
The manhole cover near the Katraj bus stand is cracked. Riders swerve every day. Please replace it.
Katraj bus stand javal manhole cha zakan tutla aahe, ek bhag khali gela aahe. Roj office la jatana baghto, konich yet nahi. Raatri disat nahi, koni tari nakki padel. Krupaya lavkar navin zakan basva.
Katraj bus stand javal manhole cha zakan tutlay! Aamhi vruddha lok tithun chalto, koni padla tar? Kiti vela sangaycha?
Undri chya navin colony madhe rasta nahi, fakt chikhal. Smart city!
उंड्रीच्या नवीन colony मध्ये अजून road नाही, फक्त माती. Rickshaw आत आणायला passengers घाबरतात, चाक अडकतं.
The new colony in Undri still has no paved road, just mud. My commute starts with a mud walk every monsoon morning.
Market Yard ke paas hostel ke bahar chaar din se kachra nahi utha. Smell itni hai ki khidki band rakhni padti hai.
Could garbage collection resume in Market Yard? It's been four days.
मार्केट यार्डमध्ये चार दिवस कचरा उचललेला नाही. मुलांना खेळायला बाहेर पाठवताना भीती वाटते.
Vadgaon Budruk madhe college javalchya shalesamor khol khadde aahet. Lahan mula roj tyatun jatat, bhiti vatate.

There are deep potholes right outside the primary school in Vadgaon Budruk. I walk past every evening and see children crossing between vehicles that swerve around them. It worries me every single day. Please fill them before a child gets hurt.
वडगाँव बुद्रुक में स्कूल के सामने गहरे गड्ढे हैं, किसी दिन बच्चा गिरेगा तब जागोगे?
FC Road pe chamber se bahut smell aati hai, rickshaw stand pe khade rehna mushkil.
FC Road वर chamber मधून घाण वास येतो. Delivery साठी थांबलो की श्वास घेणं कठीण, please cleaning करा.
The sewage chamber on FC Road near the bus stop smells terrible. I walk there every morning and it's unbearable.
Gokhale Nagar cha direction board chukicha dakhavto.
The direction board in Gokhale Nagar points the wrong way. Passengers trust the board over me. Great.
गोखलेनगरमधला दिशादर्शक फलक चुकीच्या दिशेला दाखवतो. रोज प्रवासात नवीन लोक चुकतात आणि उलटे येतात!
गणेश पेठ का footpath इतना ऊँचा है कि buzurg चढ़ ही नहीं पाते. कौन design करता है ऐसे?
गणेश पेठेतला फुटपाथ खूप उंच आहे. कॉलेजला जाताना रोज आजी-आजोबांना रस्त्यावरून चालताना पाहतो, काळजी वाटते.
Ganesh Peth cha footpath khup uncha aahe. Mi sandhyakali eklich chalat jate, ani ushira chadhayla pan tras hoto. Ramp kinva paayrya kara.
Viman Nagar che khadde paanyane bharle, swimming pool free.
Viman Nagar में बारिश के बाद potholes पानी से भर गए हैं, और depth पता ही नहीं चलती. मेरे shop के सामने रोज़ कोई न कोई bike उसमें फँसती है. Temporary नहीं, proper repair चाहिए.
Viman Nagar la khaddyat paani bharlay, depth kalat nahi. Office la jatana roj bhiti vatate, please lavkar bujva.
पर्वती में बाथरूम की नाली से गंदा पानी वापस आता है, रोज़ यही!
Sewage keeps backing up through our bathroom drain in Parvati. It's exhausting to clean every day.
Parvati la bathroom madhun gatarache paani ulta yetay.
Shaniwar Peth mein roz subah chamber overflow hota hai aur ganda paani bus stop tak aata hai. Office jaate waqt usi mein se jaana padta hai.
Shaniwar Peth ka chamber roz subah overflow, office ke kapde ganda!
Shaniwar Peth madhe roj sakali chamber bharun vahto. Delivery sathi yetana paani madhunach gaadi nyavi lagte. Krupaya line saaf karavi.
एरंडवणा में पानी का प्रेशर कम है, हॉस्टल में दिक्कत है।
Erandwane mein hamari society mein paani ka pressure bahut kam hai. Members ki taraf se nivedan hai ki line ki jaanch karwaiye.
Water pressure in Erandwane is really low. Worried about summer.
Sahakar Nagar light ped ke peeche, trim karo please.
Sahakar Nagar mein light ped mein chhup gayi, andhera!
Sahakar Nagar streetlight lost inside a tree. Trim it.
Lohegaon madhe hostel baher cha diva satat chalu-band hoto. Raatri abhyas kartana khidkitun dolyat yeto, please bulb badla.
Lohegaon mein ek streetlight flicker karti rehti hai, delivery ke time aankhon mein chubhti hai. Please bulb change karwaiye.

The streetlight outside my shop in Lohegaon has been flickering for two weeks. It's distracting for customers and bothers the families living above. It seems like a simple bulb replacement. I'd be grateful if someone could attend to it soon.
Bhavani Peth mein raat 12 ke baad lights off, dukaan band karke jaane mein dikkat!
Bhavani Peth's streetlights switch off at midnight sharp. Apparently the dark is good for us elderly folk.
Bhavani Peth la madhyaratri nantar rastyavarche dive ekdam vijhtat. Office madhun ghari yetana purna kaloch, timer thik kara.
Kondhwa ka footpath beech mein khatam, aage bhagwan bharose.
Kondhwa madhe footpath achanak sampto ani pudhe seedha highway! Office la jatana roj rastyavar utrava lagta.
कोंढवा में फुटपाथ अचानक खत्म हो जाता है, डर लगता है।
शनिवार पेठ में road का एक हिस्सा धँस गया है. कोई barricade नहीं, office जाते time रोज़ डर लगता है. कब ठीक होगा?
Shaniwar Peth mein road dhans gaya, lagta hai underground metro ka shortcut.

Shaniwar Peth madhe rastyacha ek bhag achanak khachla aahe ani mothha khadda padla aahe. Tithe kahi barricade kinva nishan nahi. Raatri disat nahi, ekhada apghat hou shakto. Krupaya lavkarat lavkar barricade lavun durusti karavi.
Dhayari mein illegal construction, kripya rokiye.
Dhayari madhe amchya college javal ek anadhikrut imarat ubhi rahtey! Parvangi cha board nahi, material rastyavar!
Dhayari में illegal construction चल रहा है, material road पे पड़ा है.
